snippet.title: Skyward Masters | Reveal Teaser 2025
snippet.description:
Skyward Masters is a brand new genre-defining arena shooter that brings 4 teams together to battle on floating islands in a thrilling and hectic environment, to be the last team standing, with an ever-changing landscape and multiple objectives along the way. Skyward Masters is inspired by the hit game mode Bedwars and established first-person shooters, combining the best of multiple worlds into a new action-packed FPS title. 

Signup for playtest: https://www.skywardmasters.com/signup
Join Discord community: https://discord.gg/GmYdzzg7Ae


👉 Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224920/Skyward_Masters/
👉 Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/skyward-masters-bc044c


Disclaimer: The footage is from Skyward Masters pre-alpha gameplay and represents work in progress. Content is subject to change.
